Files were read from the target commit, and all markers in them were counted, including markers on unchanged lines. Plan IDs were captured from both `@plan ID` and `@plan:ID` forms; suffixes and slash notation were preserved. Blame attribution was performed on every marker line at the target commit. No line contained more than one marker.

Including `.tsx` matters: the marker at `packages/cli/src/cli.tsx:42` is included above. Restricting the search to `.ts` files alone would yield 232.
